goblet-squat: Hold the weight close at chest height.
Sit down between your feet, chest up.
Push the floor away to stand tall.
leg-press: Set feet flat, about hip width, on the plate.
Lower until knees bend, hips stay on the seat.
Press back up without locking your knees hard.
db-bench: Lie flat with feet planted on the floor.
Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest.
Press up slowly, wrists stacked over elbows.
machine-chest-press: Set the seat so handles line up with mid-chest.
Press forward with your back on the pad.
Let the handles return slowly, no slamming.
seated-cable-row: Sit tall with a slight bend in your knees.
Pull the handle to your belly, elbows back.
Let your arms reach forward slowly to return.
1-arm-db-row: Rest one hand and knee on a bench.
Keep your back flat, like a table top.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, then lower.
db-rdl: Stand tall, dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Push hips back, keep the weights near your legs.
Stop when your back starts to round, then stand.
plank: Elbows under shoulders, forearms on the floor.
Keep head, hips and heels in one line.
Breathe steadily; stop when your hips sag.
lat-pulldown: Grip the bar a little wider than shoulders.
Pull the bar to your upper chest.
Let it rise slowly until arms are long.
split-squat: Stand in a long stride, feet hip width apart.
Lower the back knee straight down.
Push through the front foot to rise.
seated-db-press: Sit tall with your back against the bench.
Start with dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press up overhead, then lower with control.
hip-thrust: Rest your upper back on a bench edge.
Feet flat, knees bent, chin tucked.
Squeeze your glutes to lift hips level.
back-extension: Set the pad just below your hip bones.
Lower your chest with a long, flat back.
Rise until your body is in a straight line.
pallof-press: Stand side-on to the band or cable anchor.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press straight out and do not let it twist you.
side-plank: Elbow under shoulder, feet stacked or staggered.
Lift your hips into one straight line.
Hold steady; lower when your hips drop.
long-lever-plank: Place elbows a little ahead of your shoulders.
Squeeze glutes and keep your back flat.
Stop when the straight line breaks.
star-side-plank: Stack your shoulders and your hips.
Raise the top leg only while you stay steady.
Lower the leg first, then your hips.
wall-push-up: Hands on the wall at chest height.
Keep a straight line from head to heels.
Bend elbows to bring your chest to the wall.
incline-push-up: Hands on a sturdy bench or table edge.
Keep your body straight like a plank.
Lower your chest to the edge, then push away.
full-push-up: Hands under shoulders, body in one line.
Lower your chest to just above the floor.
Push the floor away; keep hips from sagging.
diamond-push-up: Make a diamond with thumbs and index fingers.
Keep elbows close as you lower.
Rest on your knees if your form breaks.
pseudo-planche: Hands near hips, fingers turned slightly out.
Lean forward a little and hold that lean.
Keep the lean steady through each clean rep.
vertical-row: Hold a secure anchor and lean back a little.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Pull your chest to your hands, no shrugging.
incline-row: Grip a sturdy bar or table edge at hip height.
Walk feet forward until you lean back.
Pull your chest up to the bar, then lower.
horizontal-row: Lie under a sturdy bar at waist height.
Keep your body straight, heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar, squeeze, lower.
backpack-row: Hinge at the hips with a steady, flat back.
Hold the backpack with both hands.
Pull it toward your ribs, then lower slowly.
band-row: Secure the band at chest height first.
Stand tall and step back until it is tight.
wide-row: Grip the bar wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your upper chest toward the bar.
archer-row: Use a secure anchor you trust.
Pull toward one hand; the other arm stays long.
Switch sides and keep the reps even.
assisted-squat: Hold a stable support like a door frame.
Sit down between your feet, chest up.
Use your arms only as much as you need.
bw-squat: Feet about shoulder width, toes slightly out.
Sit hips back and down, knees over toes.
Stand up tall and squeeze at the top.
bg-split-squat: Rest your back foot on a bench behind you.
Lower straight down over the front foot.
Keep the front heel down as you rise.
shrimp-squat: Stand on one foot, other knee bent behind.
Hold a wall at first for balance.
Lower only as far as you can control.
bw-rdl: Stand tall with a soft bend in your knees.
Push your hips back with a flat back.
Stand up by driving your hips forward.
sl-rdl: Stand on one leg, hold a wall if needed.
Tip forward as the free leg goes back.
Keep hips level; return to standing slowly.
banded-nordic: Kneel on a mat with ankles held secure.
Loop a band to help you on the way down.
Lower slowly, catch with your hands if needed.
nordic-curl: Kneel with ankles held firmly in place.
Keep a straight line from knees to head.
Lower as slowly as you can, hands ready.
scapular-pull: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Pull your shoulders down a little.
Relax back to a full hang, arms stay straight.
arch-hang: Hang from the bar with arms long.
Pull shoulders down, chest up a little.
Keep feet slightly forward and breathe.
pull-up-negative: Jump or step up so your chin is over the bar.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can.
Reach a full hang before the next rep.
pull-up: Hang with hands about shoulder width apart.
Pull your chest toward the bar, no swinging.
Lower to a full hang each rep.
support-hold: Press down on stable, parallel bars.
Lock elbows and stand tall between the bars.
Keep shoulders away from your ears.
dip-negative: Start at the top with arms straight.
Lower slowly until elbows reach a right angle.
Step back up rather than pushing up.
dip: Start straight-armed on stable parallel bars.
Lower until your elbows bend to a right angle.
Press back up; stop if your shoulders ache.
reverse-hyper: Lie face down with arms by your sides.
Lift chest and legs a little off the floor.
Pause, then lower slowly; keep your neck long.
